title: Clinicopathological factors associated with HER2 FISH positivity in HER2 IHC 2 + breast cancer: a multicenter study.
snippet: HER2 immunohistochemistry (IHC) 2 + breast cancer represents a clinically challenging subgroup requiring confirmatory fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) testing.
